heights.combination_method: Per-azimuth maximum of the 5 m profile from the observer to the local DEM edge and the 80 m profile from the configured overlap start to the far-field range limit. The far-field profile uses the local 5 m observer ground elevation as its common observer origin.
limitations: This is a regional horizon profile, not a globally closed lunar horizon.
Terrain beyond the far-field range limit is omitted and may raise the true horizon.
The 80 m raster cannot resolve terrain features smaller than its effective spatial resolution.
DEM vertical and horizontal uncertainties are not fully propagated into this profile.
The observer is the provisional centre of the Site01 local DEM tile, not a verified lander coordinate.
The overlap comparison supports grid alignment and elevation consistency but does not establish absolute terrain accuracy.
